# `@videojs/spf/features/hls-loading`

Source: [src/playback/features/hls-loading.ts](../../../src/playback/features/hls-loading.ts)

## hlsLoadingFeature

Fetches and parses the source's HLS multivariant playlist into the presentation the other features read.

### Behaviors

1. [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation)

### Config

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultPreload?` | `StandardPreload` | — | [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation) | Fallback used when `state.preload` is unset (undefined / empty) for the resolution-gate decision. Defaults to `'metadata'`, matching `syncPreload`'s own `defaultPreload`. |
| `parsePresentation` | `ParsePresentation` | `parseMultivariantPlaylist` | [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation) | Parses a manifest body into a resolved `Presentation`. **Required** — the behavior is format-neutral and the composing engine supplies its own parser (HLS, DASH, etc.). |
| `requestCredentials?` | `RequestCredentialsPolicy` | — | [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation) | The `credentials` mode the manifest request is made with; absent → the platform default. |

### State

| Key | Type | Initial | Declared by | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loadActivated` | `boolean \| undefined` | — | [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation) | Sticky-true per source. Flips to `true` the first time an event occurs that should switch loading behavior from preload-based to standard load (currently DOM `play` / `seeking`). Reset to `false` on source change. Read by `resolvePresentation` and `loadVideoSegments` / `loadAudioSegments` to mirror native `HTMLMediaElement` preload semantics — only meaningful when `preload !== 'auto'`, which already loads fully regardless. (documented on [trackLoadTriggers](../behaviors/dom/track-load-triggers.md#trackloadtriggers)) |
| `preload` | `"metadata" \| "auto" \| "none" \| undefined` | — | [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation) | The preload hint the engine honors. `syncPreload` keeps it in step with the element's authored `preload` attribute (both ways) and backfills its `defaultPreload` when nothing supplied one; `resolvePresentation` holds manifest resolution while it is `'none'` unless `loadActivated`, and the `loadXSegments` dispatchers choose their load mode from it. (documented on [syncPreload](../behaviors/sync-preload.md#syncpreload)) |
| `presentation` | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | — | [resolvePresentation](../behaviors/resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation) | The presentation being played. A caller writes `{ url }`; `resolvePresentation` parses the manifest and populates the rest. |
